headings: (155 G) FLEUR DE MANDARINE SCENTED CANDLE

jsonld_raw.name: (155 G) FLEUR DE MANDARINE SCENTED CANDLE
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candle made of vegetable wax.

Fleur de Mandarine | A vibrant and comforting fragrance where the citrus freshness of mandarin and orange blends with a spicy heart of green tea and nutmeg, set against a sweet and enveloping base of vanilla and mandarin jam.


Notes:
Top notes: mandarin, orange.
Heart notes: green tea, nutmeg.
Base notes: vanilla, mandarin jam.
